title: Convolution of probability densities
statement: Let $\\phi$ and $\\psi$ be probability densities on $\\mathbb{F}_2^n$. Their convolution is the probability density obtained by averaging $\\phi(y)\\psi(x-y)$ uniformly over $y\\in\\mathbb{F}_2^n$ at each point $x$.
